title: CppCon 2015: Andrei Alexandrescu “Declarative Control Flow"
summary: Andrei Alexandrescu's CppCon 2015 talk on handling exceptional control flow declaratively in C++. It uses scope guards with success and failure variants, built on std::uncaught_exceptions, to replace ad hoc RAII classes and rethrowing try/catch blocks.
why: Pointed to in threads on defer, scope_exit and RAII as the clearest treatment of scope guards.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Andrei Alexandrescu has a fun talk about implementing scope_exit
